identity.title: Jet-driven Galaxy-scale Gas Outflows in the Hyperluminous Quasar 3C 273

question.value: What are the morphology and kinematics of the ionized (ENLR) and molecular gas around the hyper-luminous quasar 3C 273, and is the outflow jet- or radiation-driven?

evidence.quote: We present an unprecedented view on the morphology and kinematics of the extended narrow-line region (ENLR) and molecular gas around the prototypical hyper-luminous quasar 3C 273

evidence.quote: In all but one case a 2 GHz correlator window (with a raw spectral resolution of 15.625 MHz) was present over the redshifted frequency of CO(1-0).

angular_resolution.value: 0.78" x 0.75" beam at PA 37 deg (~2.1 kpc), natural weighting

evidence.quote: yielding a synthesized beam of 0.78$''$ $\times$ 0.75$''$ at a position angle of 37$^{\circ}$ (a physical resolution of $\approx$2.1 kpc)

This included 8 different tracks from 5 different ALMA projects, all of which observed 3C 273 for $\approx$5 minutes in order to use it as a bandpass calibrator.

pipeline_or_manual.value: standard ALMA pipeline in CASA plus additional flagging

evidence.quote: The raw ALMA data for each track were calibrated using the standard ALMA pipeline in the `Common Astronomy Software Applications` (`CASA)` package.

self_calibration.value: three iterations of self-calibration on bright continuum

evidence.quote: Three iterations of self calibration were used to improve the phase and amplitude calibration of the data on the bright continuum in 3C 273.
The data presented here were produced using natural weighting
We use data with a channel width of 30 km s$^{-1}$, and pixels of 0.2$''$

masking.value: interactive clean regions; threshold 1.5x RMS of dirty channels

evidence.quote: The continuum-subtracted dirty cubes were cleaned in regions of source emission (identified interactively) to a threshold equal to 1.5 times the RMS noise of the dirty channels.
We subtracted the continuum emission from the data in the $uv$ plane using the `CASA` task `uvcontsub`.

final_beam.value: clean components restored with Gaussian equal to dirty beam FWHM

evidence.quote: The clean components were then added back and re-convolved using a Gaussian beam of full-width-at-half-maximum (FWHM) equal to that of the dirty beam.
with a RMS noise levels 0.18 mJy beam$^{-1}$ in each 30 km s$^{-1}$ channel.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive H2 mass from CO intensity

method.value: Cube smoothed spatially (beam FWHM) and Hanning in velocity; 3D mask at 1.5 sigma; moments from unsmoothed cube within mask

evidence.quote: A three-dimensional mask was then defined by selecting all pixels above a fixed flux threshold of 1.5 $\sigma$

validation.value: threshold adjusted to recover flux while minimizing noise

evidence.quote: adjusted to recover as much flux as possible in the moment maps while minimizing the noise

used_for.value: stellar continuum fit of MUSE data

an integrated intensity of 1.82$\pm$0.02 Jy km s$^{-1}$

findings_qualitative.value: Molecular gas forms an arc ~1.8" SW of nucleus, perpendicular to jet, kinematically quiescent (dispersion <=45 km/s, gradient ±160 km/s)

evidence.quote: appears as an “arc”-like feature about $\sim1.8\ensuremath{''}$ away from the nucleus towards the south-west almost exactly perpendicular to the jet axis

claims.hypothesis: Does the ENLR size-luminosity relation show a break at ~6-10 kpc?
claims.experiment: MUSE ENLR size at fixed surface brightness limit after AGN deblending
claims.result: R_ENLR=12.1±0.2 kpc, 2.7 sigma above proposed break
claims.finding: No break or a much larger break radius

evidence.quote: We find that the ENLR size of 3C 273 is $2.7\sigma$ larger than the proposed break radius

claims.hypothesis: Is the disturbed gas radiatively driven radially?
claims.experiment: Compare ionized gas velocity field with jet orientation
claims.result: Receding gas on the approaching jet side
claims.finding: Jet-driven cocoon acting on inclined disk is favored

evidence.quote: This is inconsistent with a purely radiatively-driven outflow which should lead to a radial gas acceleration

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Molecular gas may be bound to a stellar over-density from a recent merger rather than a density wave

evidence.quote: it is unclear whether the molecular gas is bound to a stellar over-density formed in a recent galaxy interaction or is currently forming in-situ

limitations_admitted.value: No outflow energetics computed since densities and cloud velocities cannot be measured

evidence.quote: we refrain from computing gas outflow energetics to distinguish between a mechanically or radiatively-driven outflow

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA data are a minor, low-resolution part; CO arc interpretation is speculative
Inclination estimate relies on scaling-relation stellar mass
